description.en: Same as CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_TOUGH, but restricted to TP-based clashes only (the GP side is left unaffected). Accepts the same flexible 2-4 argument forms.
True to force TP-only toughness, false to stop forcing it.
Team ID (when called with 3-4 arguments) or a character ID string (when called with exactly 2 arguments).
Optional player number within the team; only used in the 3-4 argument forms.
Optional extra mode parameter; only used in the 4-argument form.
Always null in every case, including an invalid call — this wrapper discards the result of its shared internal helper and never pushes a value of its own.
